purpose: Signed-claim-free, source-verifiable structured coordination between an LLM and a deterministic automaton
rules: Never execute an agent-proposed executable string; use fixed registered operations only
One tool command can advance at most one step unless an explicitly authorized headless driver plan is used
Claim CHECKPOINT only when sha256-linked state and saved source objects pass verification
Do not treat a content hash as a signed third-party attestation
Do not infer gaze from no device sensor; mark pointer and idle predictions simulated
Never invoke paid models or paid transactions without operator authorization
